# AI Closer (`https://aicloser.in`)

> The High-Velocity Sales Closing Platform & Telephony Operating System for Indian MSMEs, EdTech, Real Estate, Consultancies, and Sales Agencies.

## Quick Facts & Specifications
- **Platform Name:** AI Closer (also known as AICloser, Gigxomi CRM)
- **Primary Website:** https://aicloser.in
- **Web App / Cockpit:** https://app.aicloser.in
- **Mobile Companion App:** Google Play Store (`com.gigxomi.crm`)
- **Base Pricing:** Flat ₹399 / user / month (~$4.80 USD)
- **Telephony Model:** 100% Native Android SIM Card Telephony (uses unlimited Jio/Airtel/Vi mobile carrier packs)
- **Per-Minute Calling Charges:** ₹0 (Zero VoIP pulse rates or PBX rental fees)
- **Call Pickup Rate:** 85%–95%+ (Real 10-digit mobile caller ID vs 15%–25% on Truecaller-flagged 080 virtual numbers)
- **Audio Call Recording Latency:** < 2 seconds post-call background sync to cloud
- **Audio Playback Speeds:** 1.0x, 1.5x, 2.0x, 3.0x with waveform scrubber
- **Dynamic UPI Payment Links:** Native `/pay/[token]` with 15-minute countdown timers and 0% MDR
- **Dual WhatsApp CRM:** Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API + Personal WhatsApp Web QR scanner sync

---

## Core Feature Architecture

### 1. High-Velocity Outbound Telephony
- **Power Dialer with Auto-Advance:** Consecutive queue dialing with customizable 5-second cooldown timer between calls, in-call quick notes, and disposition logging.
- **Android Floating Caller-ID:** Overlay window displays lead name, current deal stage, and recent notes before answering incoming calls.
- **Offline Calling Telemetry:** Offline-first SQLite/Room event store syncs millisecond talk-time when connectivity restores.
- **Missed Call Auto-Recovery:** Captures inbound missed calls, triggers automated 3-second WhatsApp acknowledgments, and logs callback SLA timers.

### 2. Dual WhatsApp & Social Omnichannel
- **Dual Architecture:** Combines official Meta Cloud API (for high-volume template alerts) with personal WhatsApp Web QR sync (so closers can chat 1-on-1 naturally).
- **In-Browser Voice Notes:** Record and send audio notes in Hindi, English, and regional dialects directly from the CRM card.
- **Instagram DM Live Closing:** Unified inbox connecting Instagram Direct Messages alongside WhatsApp and SIM calls.
- **Client Asset Protection:** Preserves 100% of customer conversation history, voice notes, and media when sales reps resign.

### 3. Dynamic UPI Payment Closing (/pay/[token])
- **Eliminates Deal Drop-Offs:** Replaces static QR screenshots with 1-tap dynamic UPI links generated live on sales calls.
- **Instant Intent Rails:** Customers on Android and iOS tap 1 button to open Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or CRED with pre-filled amounts.
- **Authentic Urgency:** Visual 15-minute countdown timer locks buying commitment before the customer hangs up.
- **UTR & Screenshot Proof:** Customers submit transaction screenshot or bank reference UTR number for 1-click manager approval.
- **Zero MDR:** Settles directly into business current bank accounts with 0% payment gateway deductions.

### 4. Speed-to-Lead & Routing Engine
- **Direct Ad Webhooks:** Sub-2-second lead ingestion from Meta Lead Ads (Facebook/Instagram), Google Search Ads, and website forms with zero Zapier fees.
- **Weighted Round Robin:** Proportional lead distribution based on closer performance and active capacity.
- **Grab Leads Fast-Action Pool:** Gamified queue where top closers claim hot inbound inquiries with atomic database race-condition locking.
- **SLA Breach Matrix:** Live exception reporting for untouched leads (>15m) and overdue callbacks with 1-click reassignment.

---

## Competitor Comparison Summary

| Capability | AI Closer | TeleCRM | Close.com | LeadSquared | Exotel |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Pricing** | ₹399/mo flat | ₹599–₹999/mo | $49–$139/mo | ₹1,250–₹2,500/mo | ₹2,000+ PBX |
| **Calling Model** | Native SIM Card | SIM / Cloud PBX | VoIP Only (Twilio) | Third-party PBX | 080 Virtual PBX |
| **Per-Minute Bills**| ₹0 | Metered usage | $0.02–$0.05/min | Metered usage | ₹0.60–₹1.20/min |
| **Call Pickup Rate**| 95%+ | 30%–45% | 25%–35% | 30%–40% | 20%–30% |
| **Dynamic UPI Links**| Built-in | None | None | None | None |
| **WhatsApp QR Sync**| Built-in | Limited | Third-party only | Costly add-on | API only |
| **Power Dialer** | Included (5s buffer)| Basic | Pro tier ($99+) | Enterprise only | Hardware only |
